claim_scope: Separately labelled side run; not pooled with the canonical Claude-Code A/B.
objective: Measure whether lossless research-context replacement stops research transcript accretion while preserving or improving long-horizon LAB accuracy before testing demand-paged drafting.

candidate.cli_arm_note: The legacy CLI label names the frozen retrieval/whole-read surface; source fingerprints below identify the post-fix context controller.
candidate.research_context: After each evidence-bearing batch, continue from the original request, compact prior-evidence index, and latest results only.
candidate.drafting_context: Fresh drafting role plus original request and the complete selected exact-evidence union when it fits the fixed cap.

held_constant.split: visible Harvey LAB development tasks only

run_policy.concurrency: Launch all three performer cells without a serialized slot wait.
run_policy.upstream: Reuse a frozen upstream Mike result only when task, performer model, effort, transport, actual tier, and judge configuration are comparable.
run_policy.scoring: After deliverables land, use one fixed separately labelled Codex judge configuration for every compared cell; performer traces and hidden grading criteria remain isolated.

primary_gate.accuracy: Match or beat comparable pinned upstream Mike on aggregate passed criteria; efficiency cannot excuse lower accuracy.
primary_gate.context: Research per-round input must stop monotonically replaying older raw tool results; report refresh count and latest-result/evidence-union sizes.
primary_gate.drafting: Inspect whether full exact rehydration creates attention dilution, unnecessary rereads, or missed evidence despite complete availability.
primary_gate.next_ablation: Only after trace inspection, preregister a compact-map plus bounded-hot-evidence demand-paged drafting lane on the same tasks.
